content.short: dTech is a Farcaster development boutique providing growth, development and product services.
content.description: Growth-stage companies rely on dTech to accelerate expansion by solving their toughest technical challenges, streamlining product development, and delivering engaging user experiences. From concept to launch, dTech manages the full process and builds complete products—including full apps, mini-apps, and smart contracts—entirely in-house. It helps brands scale on Farcaster through expert growth consulting, strategic product feedback, and hands-on technical execution that aligns with their goals.

resources.title: How to Effect TS: Lessons From the Documentation
resources.tldr: Effect handles errors and gives visibility into a running application. A working read of the docs for people who care about production software.

resources.title: Learnings From Effect Days 2025
resources.tldr: The two biggest takeaways were not technical: there are no dumb questions, and nobody in the room is as advanced as they look.

resources.title: The Programmability Manifesto
resources.tldr: Systems do not talk to each other, and are kept closed for business reasons. An argument for treating programmability as the default.
